text:
It's an era of collaboration, not competition. 🤝

India's F&O and algo ecosystem is growing fast. Most serious traders I meet aren't short of ideas or skill. What holds them back is infrastructure: margin efficiency, execution, and the right partners.

I'm looking to connect with serious traders:
→ Algo traders and strategy developers
→ Active F&O traders (options selling, hedged strategies, intraday)
→ MFT/HFT-focused teams and quants
→ Traders looking to use their holdings more efficiently

Some ways we can work together:
• Collateral margin: pledging your equity and mutual fund holdings to unlock trading margin, within exchange and broker rules
• Execution and API access through a SEBI-registered broker, aligned with the new algo trading framework
• Structured partnerships for strategy developers who want to scale the right way, with compliance first
• Sharing knowledge on regulation, risk management and how the market is structured

This is for traders with a proven process, disciplined risk management and a long-term mindset. It's not for shortcuts or tips.

I don't think the next decade belongs to lone wolves. It belongs to people who build together: traders, technologists and wealth professionals.

If you're a serious trader building in F&O or algo trading, drop a comment or DM me. Let's talk.

Repost to help it reach a serious trader in your network. 🔁

#AlgoTrading #FnO #OptionsTrading #OptionSelling #QuantTrading #HFT #NSE #StockMarketIndia #SeriousTraders #Collaboration
